from pypdf import PdfReader
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import re, collections

pdf='/root/employees_backup.pdf'; xlsx='/root/employees_current.xlsx'
pat=re.compile(r'^(EMP\d{5}) (\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*?) ([\d,]+) (\d+)(.+) ([\d.]+)$')
old={}; parse_bad=[]
for page_no,p in enumerate(PdfReader(pdf).pages,1):
    for line in p.extract_text().splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('EMP'): continue
        m=pat.fullmatch(line)
        if not m:
            parse_bad.append((page_no,line)); continue
        empid, first,last,dept,position,salary,years,location,score=m.groups()
        old[empid]={'First':first,'Last':last,'Dept':dept,'Position':position,
                    'Salary':int(salary.replace(',','')),'Years':int(years),
                    'Location':location,'Score':float(score)}
wb=load_workbook(xlsx,read_only=True,data_only=True)
ws=wb['Employees']
rows=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True); headers=next(rows)
new={}
for vals in rows:
    row=dict(zip(headers,vals)); empid=row.pop('ID')
    if empid in new: raise ValueError(f'duplicate current ID {empid}')
    new[empid]=row
wb.close()
print('parse_bad',len(parse_bad),'old',len(old),'new',len(new))
print('old id limits',min(old),max(old),'new id limits',min(new),max(new))
print('deleted',len(old.keys()-new.keys()),sorted(old.keys()-new.keys()))
print('added',len(new.keys()-old.keys()),sorted(new.keys()-old.keys()))
diffs=[]
for empid in sorted(old.keys()&new.keys()):
    for field in headers[1:]:
        if old[empid][field] != new[empid][field]:
            diffs.append((empid,field,old[empid][field],new[empid][field]))
print('diff count',len(diffs),'modified ids',len(set(x[0] for x in diffs)))
print('by field',collections.Counter(x[1] for x in diffs))
for d in diffs: print(d)

import json, re
from pypdf import PdfReader
from openpyxl import load_workbook
report_path='/root/diff_report.json'
with open(report_path,encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)
pat=re.compile(r'^(EMP\d{5}) (\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*?) ([\d,]+) (\d+)(.+) ([\d.]+)$')
old={}
for p in PdfReader('/root/employees_backup.pdf').pages:
    for line in p.extract_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith('EMP'):
            m=pat.fullmatch(line)
            assert m, line
            i,first,last,dept,pos,sal,years,loc,score=m.groups()
            assert i not in old
            old[i]={'First':first,'Last':last,'Dept':dept,'Position':pos,'Salary':int(sal.replace(',','')),'Years':int(years),'Location':loc,'Score':float(score)}
wb=load_workbook('/root/employees_current.xlsx',read_only=True,data_only=True)
ws=wb['Employees']; it=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True); h=next(it)
assert h == ('ID','First','Last','Dept','Position','Salary','Years','Location','Score')
new={}
for vals in it:
    r=dict(zip(h,vals)); i=r.pop('ID'); assert i not in new; new[i]=r
wb.close()
expected_deleted=sorted(set(old)-set(new))
expected_modified=[]
for i in sorted(set(old)&set(new)):
    for field in h[1:]:
        if old[i][field] != new[i][field]:
            expected_modified.append({'id':i,'field':field,'old_value':old[i][field],'new_value':new[i][field]})
assert set(new) <= set(old), 'unexpected additions present'
assert report == {'deleted_employees':expected_deleted,'modified_employees':expected_modified}
assert report['deleted_employees'] == sorted(report['deleted_employees'])
assert report['modified_employees'] == sorted(report['modified_employees'],key=lambda x:x['id'])
assert all(re.fullmatch(r'EMP\d{5}',i) for i in report['deleted_employees'])
for d in report['modified_employees']:
    typ=(int,float) if d['field'] in {'Salary','Years','Score'} else (str,)
    assert isinstance(d['old_value'],typ) and not isinstance(d['old_value'],bool)
    assert isinstance(d['new_value'],typ) and not isinstance(d['new_value'],bool)
print(f'validated {len(old)} PDF records and {len(new)} Excel records; {len(expected_deleted)} deletions and {len(expected_modified)} field modifications; report is exhaustive and sorted')
